3137.title: Window panel alignment in split layouts
3137.rootCauseOneLine: No offset reproduced: the 10px top position and 28px control height center exactly in the 48px header row.
3137.proposedFix: Capture computed geometry in an affected browser before changing the currently aligned production layout.
3137.caveats: The reported nightly/browser state was unavailable; the independent absolute-positioning path exists but produced a 0px center delta in both clean runs.
